title: Master Regulators and Cofactors of Human Neuronal Cell Fate Specification Identified by CRISPR Gene Activation Screens
model: TUBB3-mCherry dCas9-VP64 iPSCs, CRISPRa paired with sgNGN3
paper_method: per-guide DESeq2; TF hit = 2+ guides enriched in two contrasts (FDR<0.01)
paper_calls: Positive neurogenic TFs listed in Table S1
barcs_calls: 109 genes at FDR 0.10 after control calibration
verdict: BARCS recovers 26/27 of the paper's positive neurogenic TFs for this screen as enriched at FDR 0.10, with the same proneural TFs (NEUROD/NEUROG, SOX, KLF families) at the top.
